**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true` at 02:13:41.234Z. The size-20 pool saturated in 37s. Every 503 carries `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

Impact: 02:14:18.972Z to 03:59:27.974Z, 530 errors, still open at log end. `/health` stayed 200, so alerts missed it.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Also check node-1 and node-2 — this log is node-3 only.
